renderBackend: Headless Linux Chromium, ANGLE SwiftShader; 390x844 portrait; Android UA and native lifecycle callback fixture; actual Three.js WebGL2 scene
method: Open stock game from local Android web export; settle entrance camera at its own destination. Observe 32 seconds of opening scene; hook every actual render and time CSS2DRenderer.render. Read Three.js counters, viewport and JS heap. Simulate a 4.5 second native inactive interval while document remains visible. Verify scene resumes, place-label switch, and byte compare frozen scene with/without a magenta sheet directly below seabed across three views (RGB delta >2). No UI or shader quality changes are injected during the observation window.
limits: Benchmarks ran under variable VM contention. Random live actors, asset loading and elapsed simulation differ; scene-object counts, memory and timing are snapshots, not controlled phone throughput, battery, GPU duration, leak tests or temperature. Geometries and textures are object counts, not VRAM bytes. Shifts in triangle/draw counts reflect combined game changes. Baseline native callback frame count >0 is observed while inactive. An older probe lacked the hudFps field on the baseline.
